Devina Rao: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands reliability segment. Posting RCA + action asks here. slides: https://notion.redwood/internals/allhands/2026-03-28 :spiral_note_pad:
Sam Torres: RCA link? I want to include it in the customer update.
Devina Rao: RCA: https://docs.redwood.company/incidents/RC-2026-03-28-cache-amplification  short summary in first para.
Nora (Eng Lead): Root cause: rare request amplification triggered by inflight routing race. Hotfix rolled to short-circuit and limit inflight on routers.
Lee Chen: Hotfix PR: https://git.redwood/infra/routers/pulls/341  config added and staging canary is green.
Sam Torres: Can we capture owners + due dates for follow-ups so CS/product can coordinate?
Nora (Eng Lead): Action A - complete global rollout verification + post latency heatmaps. Owner: Lee Chen. Due: 2026-03-30.
Nora (Eng Lead): Action B - add inflight and kv-miss pagers + dashboards. Owner: Nora. Due: 2026-04-07.
Devina Rao: Action C - customer note + contact. Owner: Devina & CS. Due: 2026-03-29 EOD.
Sam Torres: Leadership ask: do we reprioritize canary automation? I recommend accelerating by one sprint.
Nora (Eng Lead): I'll raise in leadership sync; estimate ~2 engineer-weeks to prototype, 1 sprint to harden.
incident-bot: Incident RC-2026-03-28 status -> mitigated. RCA published: https://docs.redwood.company/incidents/RC-2026-03-28-cache-amplification :white_check_mark:
Devina Rao: Thanks all  please update the RCA page with any follow-ups and mark actions done when complete.
